correctness.rationale: All allowable sign configurations are classified exactly; iid symmetric continuity makes magnitude ranks uniformly distributed. The factorial identity and cube-density normalization prove the angle/volume formula. Strict convexity of every positive rank summand, with a strictly convex first summand, proves class-size majorization. A dominated geometric binomial-tail argument proves the balanced fixed-class limit; binomial symmetry gives the concentrated asymptotic. The standalone exact enumeration independently checks twelve profiles, 880232 signed-rank assignments, 378 strict convexity instances and 535 majorization pairs.
